items.source: Uses of AsyncWebRequestInterceptor in org.springframework.orm.jpa.support
items.translation: `AsyncWebRequestInterceptor` 接口在 `org.springframework.orm.jpa.support` 包中的用法

items.source:
Spring web request interceptor that binds a JPA EntityManager to the
thread for the entire processing of the request.
items.translation: 用于在整个请求处理过程中将 JPA EntityManager 绑定到线程的 Spring Web 请求拦截器。
